title: Electromagnetism II
prerequisites: P6a, P3, P4; M8a and M8b useful.
purpose: Derive electromagnetic propagation and radiation results and connect conservation laws to fields.

blocks.deliverable: Derive a field energy balance with boundary flux.
Solve a plane wave and identify field directions.
Derive coefficients and check energy conservation.
Week 7 midterm; find a cutoff frequency for a simple geometry.
Explain retardation and distinguish near and far fields.
Verify invariance of physical fields under a gauge change.
Present the radiation calculation and complete the final.

project: Calculate radiation from a simple oscillating dipole and check angular and dimensional behavior.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
